text:
emily: dropped a revised compact card for latency panels — this one stacks p95, tiny heatmap, and a sampling chip into a single row for narrow dashboards. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz6789/latency-compact-v2
kevin: nice iteration. quick visual note: the sampling chip currently uses a green dot + light green bg. contrast is borderline on monitors with low brightness. can we switch to an outline + filled icon to keep it lighter visually but meet contrast?
priya: also for the p95 number, when we shrink to list view the glyph spacing tightens and it reads like 12ms vs 1 2ms. consider tabular nums or letter-spacing tweak.
anya: accessibility: tab order seems okay, but the sampling toggle is implemented as a button. we should make it a `role="switch"` and expose `aria-checked`. screen reader users need to know sampling rate too (`aria-label="Sampling on, 5%"`).
emily: thanks. i'll change to switch role and expose the rate.
marcus: animation nit — collapse currently moves the p95 horizontally which makes a long list feel jumpy while scanning. can we crossfade the heatmap instead and keep the p95 container fixed width so numbers don't shift?
 emily: good call. i'll lock metric layout width and fade the heatmap.
kevin: microcopy suggestion for the sampling tooltip: current text "sampling enabled" is vague. propose "Sampling enabled — reporting ~5% of requests. Click to change." Also we should show a fallback indicator when sampling is off and p95 is estimated.
priya: +1. for small counts, show `—` and tooltip: "p95 unavailable (<100 samples). Consider increasing window or enabling sampling." Keep it short.
a11y-bot: Automated checks: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for numeric p95 in compact mode; provide visible focus ring with at least 3px offset; switch must be keyboard operable and announce state changes. Add live-region update when sampling rate changes.
emily: re: live-region — do we want a toast or an inline sr-only message?
ya na: sr-only inline is less disruptive for screen readers. a brief `aria-live="polite"` text that says "Sampling now 5%" should be enough.
marcus: responsive note: on mobile narrow widths the sampling chip wraps and pushes the heatmap down. prefer a single-line clamp with overflow ellipsis and the chip on the far right, not wrapping.
kevin: also, will the compact card appear in table rows? if so we should allow a hover state that shows the full heatmap in a tooltip (hover/long-press).
emily: yep will prototype hover popover with full heatmap and show refresh timestamp in the popover footnote.
priya: one last copy nit: in the compact header we currently use `p95` lowercase. consider `P95` or `p95 (ms)` — teams get mixed signals. maybe show `p95` label small and value big with unit.
emarcus: +1 to unit. helps when units change (ms vs s).
emily: I'll push update by EOD: fixed-width metric container, crossfade heatmap, switch role + aria, sr-only live update, new sampling tooltip copy, hover popover for full heatmap, and mobile clamp. Will post a before/after screenshot. Thanks all :raised_hands:
a11y-bot: Reminder: Add keyboard-only screenshot tests and a contrast test for compact card variants after design update.
